workload: One original 20,000-event file, all five MET states through closed histogram. Matched pairs are within each row.

trials.label: Hard terms once per event
trials.decision: Numerically exact. Test repeated with roles reversed because nominal also moved.

trials.label: Hard terms once, reversed order
trials.decision: Restored faithful. Full paired repeat overlaps the 0.5% improvement threshold.

trials.label: Skip repeated empty link projections
trials.decision: Retained with unchanged faithful native library.

trials.label: Read jet sampling only as fallback
trials.decision: Retained on qualified full gain. Intermediate nominal cohorts failed spread screens.

trials.label: 5,000 events per chunk
trials.decision: Retained; exact empty and partial chunks. One larger fixed chunk size tested separately.

trials.label: 10,000 events per chunk
trials.decision: Kept 5,000. The larger fixed chunk took longer on average and used an extra 73 MiB.

trials.label: Index recursive branch names once
trials.decision: Retained. Both full and nominal qualified; projection order and field inventory matched.

trials.label: Share cluster sampling buffers
trials.decision: Retained. The three paired full savings were 21, 56 and 103 ms.

trials.label: Reuse the identical first Gaussian
trials.decision: Retained for full. Nominal never invokes the RNG and its timing showed no benefit.

trials.label: Borrow typed scalar link fields
trials.decision: Retained. Generic representation remains available and checked.

trials.label: Check jet track offsets once
trials.decision: Retained after qualified primary full measurement, independent operation counts and exact stock acceptance.

trials.label: Check jet track offsets once, reversed order
trials.decision: Reverse full exceeded spread limits. Nominal qualified.
